station.building_description:
LOCATION AND GEOMETRY (high confidence; from the OSM way 841790852 polygon, computed by me):
- Passenger building "Gara Pascani". Footprint centroid is 47.25689, 26.72403, which matches Nominatim (47.25689, 26.72403). Its bbox runs from lat 47.25639 to 47.25743 and lon 26.72360 to 26.72442.
- The OSM railway=station node "Pașcani" (id 3120900494, uic_ref 5351358, operator CFR) is at 47.25691, 26.72454, on the track side.
- Ground elevation is about 213.6 m (EU-DEM 25 m via opentopodata).
- The long axis runs at a bearing of 158.3 / 338.3 deg (NNW–SSE), parallel to the tracks.
- Overall size is about 116 m long and about 20 m deep.

Footprint vertices, in lat,lon order going around the polygon:
47.25736,26.72360; 47.25743,26.72385; 47.25645,26.72442; 47.25639,26.72418; 47.25650,26.72411; 47.25651,26.72417; 47.25682,26.72399; 47.25680,26.72394; 47.25695,26.72384; 47.25697,26.72389; 47.25727,26.72371; 47.25725,26.72366.

Plan shape (computed from the polygon):
- The EAST (track) façade is one straight wall of about 116 m.
- The WEST (town/square) façade is stepped, from north to south:
  - end pavilion, about 12.6 m long, full depth about 20 m
  - wing, about 36 m long, set back about 4.6 m (depth about 15.5 m)
  - central body, about 18.3 m long, full depth about 20 m, projecting toward the square
  - wing, about 36 m long, set back about 4.6 m
  - end pavilion, about 13.2 m long, full depth about 20 m
- This matches the CFR tender wording "corp central si cele doua corpuri laterale" (central body and two side wings).

ARCHITECTURE (medium confidence; my own reading of the 2009 Commons photo Gara_Pascani.jpg):
- Mostly a single storey: a long ground-floor hall with a continuous arcade/portico of square concrete pillars on the platform side and a flat canopy over platform 1.
- A two-storey block with a hipped roof (grey sheet or tile, small dormers) and a two-storey end pavilion rise above it.
- Walls are plastered and painted light grey/off-white, with a plain, sober 20th-century look (possibly post-war or interwar; this is not verified).
- A blue CFR "PAȘCANI" sign and a clock hang on the platform façade. Ground-floor shops include a "FAST FOOD" unit.
- Platforms are paved with red concrete pavers, with globe-lamp lighting posts and catenary masts.
- Architect, exact construction year and heritage (LMI) status: NOT FOUND in any source checked. ro.wikipedia's "Gara Pașcani" article is a stub with no history.

HISTORY:
- The railway reached Pașcani with the Lemberg–Czernowitz–Jassy company's Roman–Pașcani–Iași line in 1869–1870. The Pașcani–Iași section was completed in May 1870 (iasi.travel; local history pieces). Medium-high confidence.
- An Illustrated London News engraving dated 30 Dec 1876 shows an earlier station building ("Russian volunteers at the railway station, Paschkanyi").
- Newsweek.ro (2025) lists Pașcani among the Lemberg–Czernowitz company's junction stations with "more refined architectural compositions". That applies to the original typology; the present building looks later.
- The CFR railway workshops on Str. Garii date from 1876 and are listed as a monument (ro.wikipedia "Pașcani"). They employed more than 1,000 people in 1925. Today they are Electroputere VFU Pașcani, which modernised 42 CFR Calatori coaches under PNRR (completed June 2026). This is a coach-modernisation project, not a station project.

CURRENT STATE AND RENOVATION (high confidence for the tender facts):
- No PNRR project for the station building was found.
- CFR SA tendered "Modernizarea statiei CF Pascani" in July 2023 (capital.ro and antena3.ro, 6–7 Jul 2023). Funding was non-reimbursable money from the Programul Transporturi (PT). Value was 33.98 million lei excl. VAT (about 7 M EUR).
- Tender scope:
  - consolidation and modernisation of the passenger building (central body plus two lateral wings)
  - reorganisation of the passenger, commercial and operational spaces
  - rebuilding the main platform in front of the building to 250 m x 6 m, with canopies over the central and lateral bodies
  - ramps and tactile strips for people with reduced mobility
  - a pedestrian level crossing at the station's "X" end
  - a modern passenger information system and modern platform lighting
  - a car park in front of the station
- Timeline: 25 months (6 design + 4 approvals + 18 works + 1 handover), with a 60-month warranty.
- Status: bzi.ro reported on 5 Jan 2024 that the works tender was annulled because the single bid was non-compliant. The consultancy/supervision tender (616,610 lei) was being relaunched for the 3rd time (deadline 30 Jan 2024). The project was described as blocked.
- No news after 2024 about a signed contract was found. Treat the station as NOT yet modernised (medium confidence).

Related corridor study:
- CFR finished a feasibility study for modernising the Pașcani–Darmanesti section of line 500 (71 km) on 31 Mar 2025. SMIS 151660, value 6.216 M lei, POIM funding.
- Target: double track, 25 kV, interoperable, 120–160 km/h for passenger trains, 100–120 km/h for freight. TEN-T Core, Pan-European Corridor IX.
station.tracks_platforms:
OSM cross-section perpendicular to the tracks through the building centre (computed by me from OSM; high confidence for geometry, medium for track roles). Offsets are measured eastward (bearing 68 deg) from the building centreline. The building spans -10 m to +10 m.

Platforms and tracks, west to east:
- +10 m: east (track-side) wall of the building.
- About +17 m: platform 1, a side platform along the building (OSM way 481440039, about 313 m long, bearing 158 deg). Per the 2009 photo it is covered by the building's portico canopy.
- About +21 m: track tagged ref 517 (Pașcani – Târgu Neamț line, electrified in the OSM tag).
- About +25 m: line 500 main track (way 807803275).
- About +26.5 to +32 m: island platform 2, about 5.7 m wide (way 481440037).
- About +34 m: line 500 main track (way 481440027).
- About +38 m: line 606 main track toward Iași (way 940006947).
- About +40 to +46 m: island platform 3, about 6.5 m wide (way 481440036).
- About +48 and +51 m: two electrified sidings (ways 481440032, 481440845).
- About +57 and +62 m: yard tracks.
- About +180 m: spurs into the Electroputere VFU works.

Summary:
- About 5 through passenger tracks plus about 2 electrified sidings at the passenger station.
- 3 platforms: 1 side platform and 2 island platforms.
- The catenary is 25 kV AC (contact_line).

Building side:
- The passenger building is on the WEST side of the tracks, the town side facing Str. Garii / Str. Ceferistilor.

Crossing the tracks:
- There is NO underpass at the station.
- In the photo, platforms are reached at grade, by walkways across the tracks.
- A pedestrian footbridge crosses the whole track bundle about 400 m north of the building (OSM way 848190254, bridge=yes, footway, layer 1). It runs from 47.26073, 26.72186 to 47.26096, 26.72257 and is about 57 m long. It is visible in the 2009 photo.
- The 2023 modernisation plan adds a pedestrian level crossing at the X end, ramps and tactile strips.

Lines served:
- CFR Magistrala 500 (București Nord – Ploiești Sud – Adjud – Bacău – Roman – Pașcani – Suceava – Vicșani). Pașcani is at km 386+191 (bzi.ro).
- Line 606 Pașcani – Târgu Frumos – Iași, 76 km (OSM ref 606; Wikipedia "CFR Line 600" lists 606 as Iași – Târgu Frumos – Pașcani).
- Line 517 Pașcani – Târgu Neamț (OSM ref 517; ro.wikipedia lists a secondary line to Târgu Neamț).

Adjacent stations (ro.wikipedia infobox): Lunca Siretului, Pașcani Triaj, Ruginoasa (toward Iași), Topile (toward Târgu Neamț).

Pașcani Triaj marshalling yard:
- Station node "Triaj Pascani" (uic 5351346) is at 47.23834, 26.73565, about 2.2 km SSE.
- Large yard fans of OSM service=yard tracks fill the area south-east of the passenger station toward it.
- An OSM turntable (railway=turntable) is at 47.25237, 26.72930, about 600 m SE of the building, which indicates a locomotive depot area.
station.surroundings:
STREETS (OSM, high confidence):
- Str. Garii (tertiary): runs NNW–SSE along the west side of the station, in front of the building. Address: Gara Pascani, Strada Garii, 705200 Pașcani (Nominatim). It continues north to about 47.2614, 26.7206 and south-east toward the yards.
- Str. Ceferistilor (tertiary): comes from the WSW (about 47.2549, 26.7172) and reaches the station square at about 47.2567, 26.7233.
- Other nearby streets: Str. 22 Decembrie (47.2555, 26.7234), Aleea Izvoarelor, Str. Mihai Eminescu, Str. Vasile Alecsandri, Str. Victoriei, and pedestrian Str. Cuza Voda / Esplanada (about 47.2532–47.2536, 26.7232–26.7236) leading south toward the centre.
- The main through road is DN28A (Str. Moldovei / Str. Gradinitei / Str. Ștefan cel Mare). It passes about 1.0–1.5 km S/SW of the station, with DJ208 (Str. Dragoș Voda) to the west.
- On the east side of the tracks: Str. 9 Mai and Str. Tamaduirii, plus Str. Unirii (DC125) at about 47.2627, 26.7294.

STATION SQUARE (OSM):
- A parking area (OSM way 1557792410) lies directly west of the building, bbox lat 47.25636–47.25782, lon 26.72318–26.72414.
- A bus station node (amenity=bus_station) is at 47.25668, 26.72384, in front of the south half of the building.
- Police point at 47.25736, 26.72366 and doctors' office at 47.25713, 26.72399, both at the north end of the building.
- CEC Bank at 47.25699, 26.72283.
- Pizzeria/fast food at 47.25630, 26.72342.
- Market hall (amenity=marketplace) at about 47.25657, 26.72169, on Str. Ceferistilor. Bzi.ro reports the Pașcani town hall's modernisation of the Str. Ceferistilor market (about 12–13 M EUR contract).

WEST SIDE (between the station and the centre):
- 5-storey socialist-era apartment blocks: G3, G4, G6, G7 at about 47.2553–47.2557, 26.7227–26.7239; B23, C17, C21; and others along Str. Mihai Eminescu / Aleea Izvoarelor.
- A school at 47.25551, 26.72071.
- Biserica Sfânta Vineri at 47.25572, 26.71858.

EAST SIDE OF THE TRACKS:
- Electroputere VFU Pașcani industrial site (former CFR workshops, OSM landuse=industrial, centroid 47.25690, 26.72778, bbox 47.2527–47.2613 / 26.7225–26.7324).
- Large industrial halls at about 47.2559–47.2565, 26.7265–26.7288.
- Further east is the Siret river floodplain.

CITY CENTRE:
- Primaria Municipiului Pașcani (town hall, Str. Mihail Kogalniceanu) is at 47.24512, 26.72408, about 1.3 km due south of the station.
- Palatul Cantacuzino-Pașcanu is at 47.24519, 26.72785, about 1.35 km SSE.
- Casa de Cultura Mihail Sadoveanu is at 47.24987, 26.71971.
- Hotel Central (6 levels) is at 47.25013, 26.72061.
- The centre sits on a terrace about 243 m a.s.l., while the station is at about 214 m. The city therefore rises about 29 m from the station toward the centre. Pedestrian stairs "Scarile mari" (47.25087, 26.72154) and "Scarile mici" (47.25025, 26.72267) climb this slope.

RIVER SIRET:
- Pașcani lies on the right (west) bank of the Siret. The river flows roughly N–S in a wide floodplain EAST of the town and of the railway.
- An OSM river segment named Siret has its centroid at 47.24047, 26.76649 (about 3.7 km ESE of the station, about 208 m a.s.l.).
- The nearest course is roughly 2.5–4 km east (medium confidence).
- Unnamed streams/channels in OSM also run about 1.5 km west of the station.
station.traffic_facts:
- Major CFR junction in Moldavia. It is where line 500 (București – Suceava – Vicșani, TEN-T Core / Pan-European Corridor IX) meets line 606 to Iași (76 km) and the branch 517 to Târgu Neamț. Sources: ro/en Wikipedia, OSM. High confidence.
- It is the transfer point between the Bucharest/Bacău – Suceava axis and Iași. ro.wikipedia calls it "un important nod de cale ferata"; en.wikipedia calls it "a key node in the CFR rail network".
- Station on line 500 at km 386+191. It handles both passenger and freight traffic and is administered by CFR SA – Sucursala Regionala CF (SRCF) Iași (bzi.ro, 5 Jan 2024).
- Pașcani Triaj marshalling yard is about 2.2 km SSE (OSM station node 47.23834, 26.73565, uic 5351346). Extensive electrified yard tracks run between it and the passenger station.
- An OSM turntable at 47.25237, 26.72930 indicates a locomotive depot/maintenance area SE of the station.
- Electroputere VFU Pașcani (the former CFR workshops, dating from 1876, about 1,000 workers in 1925) sits directly east of the tracks. It modernised 42 CFR Calatori coaches (about 67 M EUR, PNRR) in 2024–2026.
- Services: regional trains Pașcani – Iași and Târgu Neamț – Pașcani – Iași. A Commons photo from 14 Apr 2023 shows train R5522, 10:10 Târgu Neamț – Iași, with a Class 41 DMU reversing at Pașcani. InterRegio services also call on line 500 (București – Suceava) and on Iași – Timișoara/Cluj routes. nachtzug.net lists 3 overnight connections (to București, Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara) as of an unverified date.
- Exact trains per day and passenger counts: NOT FOUND in official sources. Check the CFR Calatori "Mersul trenurilor" timetable to get them. Do not invent a figure.
- Town population is 30,766 (2021 census).

geo.terrain: CONFIDENCE in brackets. [HIGH] Pascani lies at the southern edge of the Suceava Plateau (Podisul Sucevei), on the WEST/RIGHT bank of the Siret. Wikipedia RO gives 230 m in the lead and a 210-250 m range in the infobox. The Siret does NOT cross the town. It flows NNW to SSE about 2.5-3 km EAST of the station: 47.36500,26.66850 -> 47.29690,26.72810 -> 47.25440,26.76010 (level with the station) -> 47.20820,26.78920 (level with the A8) -> 47.15980,26.79220 (OSM way 16883181, sampled). The flood plain and meadow (lunca) between the railway and the Siret sit at 204-206 m (SRTM30). East of the river are Blagesti (47.24966,26.76431) and Harmanestii Noi, then gentle hills at about 245 m. SRTM30 elevation profile: station forecourt 212 m on the low terrace; the railway, Electroputere works and marshalling yard (Triaj, 47.23834,26.73565) all on the flat 210-220 m terrace; the old centre sits on a higher terrace step at 236-241 m (city hall 236, Cantacuzino palace 241). Pedestrian stairs 'Scarile mari' (47.25087,26.72154) and 'Scarile mici' climb this step, so the edge of the terrace is a visible scarp. West of town the ground rises steadily: 266 m at 26.690 (the A7 corridor), 344 m at 26.660 (Gastesti) and about 397 m at 47.26,26.64. These are the wooded hills of the plateau. The A7/A8 turbine interchange sits on a terrace slope at about 250-265 m (264 m at 47.2135,26.7050), so it is about 50 m above the station, 5 km to the SSW. That is an average grade of about 1%, with steeper sections of 2.5-3% near the end. Tributaries and streams [MEDIUM, OSM]: (1) Raul Zmeul rises west of Sodomeni and flows ESE just SOUTH of the interchange (47.20790,26.69890 -> 47.19900,26.72430 -> 47.18810,26.75340) to the Siret near Stolniceni-Prajescu. (2) A stream unnamed in OSM drains the western hills north-west of the station (47.25590,26.70020 -> 47.27860,26.71160 -> 47.29180,26.73120) and joins the Siret flood plain near Lunca; the DJ208 Dragos Voda bridge (47.25829,26.70460) crosses it. (3) Raul Iermolea flows further NW (47.27170,26.63990). (4) A small drainage/industrial canal runs beside the SE industrial zone (47.24390,26.73350 -> 47.24000,26.73900). (5) A small brook runs under DJ208 Stefan cel Mare at 47.23370,26.72561 (bridge). Railways [HIGH, OSM]: CFR line 500 (Suceava-Roman) runs N-S through the station and continues south on the flood-plain terrace via 47.24510,26.73140, Triaj, 47.22710,26.73920 and Stolniceni-Prajescu 47.20320,26.74120. Line 606 to Iasi branches east just south of the station, via 47.24850,26.75180 and 47.24030,26.76760, crossing the Siret at about 47.2410,26.7665. Line 517 to Targu Neamt branches WNW via 47.27090,26.70660. Motorways [HIGH, OSM data tagged under construction plus press reports]: the A7 Lot 3 (Mircesti-Pascani) runs NNW-SSE about 2-3 km WEST of the town (47.19787,26.72233 -> 47.21012,26.70992 -> 47.22251,26.69755 -> 47.23905,26.70160 -> 47.25358,26.69415 -> 47.26443,26.69068), between the town and the western hills. The A8 runs roughly W-E at latitude 47.20-47.215. It comes from Targu Neamt (47.19845,26.56639), passes the turbine, goes east over CFR line 500 at about 47.2121,26.7410 just north of Stolniceni-Prajescu, crosses the Siret flood plain at about 47.2055,26.7900 and continues towards Targu Frumos/Iasi (47.20822,26.84840). A second, ordinary A7 interchange with DN28A/DJ208 lies WEST of town near Gastesti/Bosteni, with ramp clusters around 47.2425,26.6840 and 47.2525-47.2614,26.6870-26.6940 [MEDIUM].

geo.light_rail_corridor_suggestion: RECOMMENDED corridor A, about 5.5-6 km, keeps clear of the dense old centre on the upper terrace. Stops: (0) Gara Pascani intermodal hub on the station forecourt (47.25690,26.72430, 212 m), next to the bus station (47.25668,26.72384). (1) South inside or beside the CFR line 500 right-of-way, along its west/east edge past the Electroputere VFU works (47.25703,26.72745) and 47.25200,26.72900. This land is flat at about 212 m with railway and industrial use, so no houses need to be demolished. (2) Under or beside the DN28A Strada Gradinitei overpass (47.24479,26.73130). A stop here, about 400 m from the hospital and the Cantacuzino palace, serves the centre. (3) South past the industrial zone to the Triaj/marshalling yard edge (47.23834,26.73565). (4) Curve SW across the industrial land (47.23945,26.73076 / 47.23316,26.71674) and join DJ208 Strada Stefan cel Mare near its small stream bridge (47.23370,26.72561). (5) South on DJ208 to the Strada Crizantemelor / DJ208L fork (47.22920,26.72850). (6) Follow DJ208L SW (47.22520,26.72290 -> 47.21900,26.71650). This road runs right through the turbine footprint (DJ208L continues to 47.19820,26.69500) and climbs from about 219 m to about 250-264 m, a 2.5-3% grade, which is fine for light rail. (7) Terminal 'Turbion Park & Ride / Mobility Hub' outside the ramp loops, on the NE side of the interchange, at about 47.21600-47.21900, 26.71200-26.71650 (approximate; the exact land between ramps should be checked on satellite imagery). Connections there: coaches and shuttles onto the A7 (towards Bacau BCM and, later, north towards Suceava SCV) and the A8 (east towards Iasi IAS, west towards Targu Neamt). This corridor crosses no major river; it needs only small culverts/bridges at the brook by DJ208 (47.2337,26.7256). ALTERNATIVE B, about 7.6 km and flatter: stay beside CFR line 500 all the way south via 47.22710,26.73920 to the point where the A8 crosses line 500 (about 47.21210,26.74100, north of Stolniceni-Prajescu), then run west about 2.7 km in or beside the A8 right-of-way (47.21500,26.72000 -> 47.21450,26.70900) to the turbine. This uses only transport land, but it is longer and climbs about 50 m in its last 3 km. Both options stay WEST of the Siret, which lies about 2.5-4 km to the east, so neither needs a crossing of that river. The Siret flood plain (204-206 m) should be kept as a green buffer and could hold the PV/solar fields. Straight-line distance from the station to the turbine centre (47.21400,26.70550) is 5.0 km.
geo.population_facts: Pascani municipality (Iasi County, NW part of the county): 30,766 inhabitants at the 2021 census, 33,745 at the 2011 census (Wikipedia RO). The OSM place node still carries the 1992 census figure, 35,897. Area 75.32 sq km. Component localities: Pascani (seat), Blagesti, Bosteni, Gastesti, Lunca and Sodomeni. Status: urban commune from 1931, raion seat 1950-1968, municipality since 1995. First documentary mention 1419, in a charter of Alexandru cel Bun. Pascani is an important CFR railway junction: line 500 Suceava-Roman, the main line to Iasi (606) and the secondary line to Targu Neamt (517). The railway workshops date from 1876. Postal code 705200, SIRUTA 95408.

node.node_name: Nodul rutier turbion Pascani (A7 x A8), also reported as "nodul turbion Pascani-Sodomeni"; first turbine-type motorway interchange in Romania. Part of A7 Bacau-Pascani Lot 3 Mircesti-Pascani.
node.node_type: Turbine ("turbion") interchange, fully directional, with high-speed ramps for every movement. Facts from DRDP Iasi/CNAIR via news reports (economedia 2025-05, antena3 and newsweek 2026-07-13/14). High confidence: 8 ramps (bretele) with a design speed of 80 km/h and radii of 400-600 m; 12 overpasses/pasaje (8 on the A7, 4 on the A8); 5 culverts (podete). The node covers about 220 ha and is roughly 2 km long. Newsweek's headline says it has 3 levels (etaje); medium confidence, since other articles do not state a level count. OSM data (Overpass, 2026-11-17): 32 motorway_link ways (highway=construction, construction=motorway_link, opening_date=2026). Many are bridge=yes with layer=1, and the mainlines carry bridge segments at layer 1. The ramp footprint bbox is lat 47.20591-47.22180, lon 26.69051-26.72323, with ramp centroid 47.21363,26.70596. The node coordinate is the computed crossing of the A7 and A8 mainline centrelines in OSM (4 carriageway crossings within about 15 m of 47.21388,26.70568). The OSM status tag for Lot 3 gives builder UMB, PNRR financing, and physical progress of 55.70% on 30.08.2026 (54.6% on 31.07.2026, 41% on 31.12.2025).
node.location_description: South-west of Pascani, Iasi County, inside Pascani municipality next to the village of Sodomeni, between the Pascani and Stolniceni-Prajescu administrative areas. Distances and directions are computed from OSM place nodes. Sodomeni is 1.9 km WNW of the node (47.22233,26.68448), Bosteni 2.6 km NW (47.23199,26.68435), Stolniceni-Prajescu 2.8 km ESE (47.20389,26.73951), Bratesti 3.1 km S (47.18644,26.70406), and the Pascani town centre 4.1 km NNE (47.24808,26.72564). Pascani station (OSM node 3120900494) is at 47.25691,26.72454, which confirms the approximate 47.25N 26.73E. The node is 4.99 km from the station, on a bearing of 197 deg (SSW) from the station. Triaj Pascani station (47.23834,26.73565) is 3.5 km NE of the node, on the rail line south of the main station, and could serve as an intermediate stop for a light-rail line. The nearest A7 point to the station is 47.24830,26.70159, about 2.0 km WSW, because the A7 bypasses Pascani on the west side. The Siret river runs east of the town (nearest point about 47.23970,26.75281, 4.6 km E of the node); the node is on the west terrace and the A8 crosses the Siret east of the node, around lon 26.75-26.77. DN28A (Strada Moldovei / Strada Gradinitei through Pascani) passes 3.4 km N of the node. The E85/DN2 corridor runs further west, through the Motca area. The A7 also has a separate local interchange, Nod Pascani, west of the town at about 47.2553,26.6905 (ramps between 47.2533 and 47.2632); there A7 Lot 3 ends and A7 Pascani-Suceava Lot 1 begins. Medium-high confidence on this layout, based on OSM geometry.
node.a7_route_near_pascani: A7 Autostrada Moldovei. Bacau-Pascani section, 77 km, Lot 3 Mircesti-Pascani: 28.09 km, contract signed 15.02.2023, consortium UMB / SA&PE Construct / Tehnostrade, 1.766 bn lei excluding VAT, PNRR funds. Status: under construction. Asphalting at the turbine started July 2026; OSM progress is 55.7% on 30.08.2026. The official target is opening by end of 2026; Economedia estimates December 2026. Confidence medium, since no opening is confirmed as of 2026-11-17. Route in OSM (construction=motorway, ref=A7, name "Lot 3"): it comes from the south-east at about 47.04884,26.85005, near Mircesti and the Siret, and runs NNW through 47.12278,26.77334, 47.16126,26.74047, 47.18758,26.72710 and 47.20041,26.72005. It crosses the A8 at the turbine (47.21388,26.70568), then continues north along the west side of Pascani through 47.22334,26.69717, 47.23648,26.70256, 47.24988,26.70004 and the Pascani interchange (about 47.2553,26.6905), and ends at about 47.26325,26.68984. North of that, OSM has A7 "Lot 1" Pascani-Suceava (construction, no opening date) through 47.27361,26.69879, 47.28743,26.69708, 47.31060,26.67427, 47.33289,26.64947, 47.35877,26.64714, 47.38296,26.66074 and 47.40018,26.62958, heading towards Roscani. Pascani-Suceava Lot 1 runs from Nod Pascani to Nod Roscani, about 33 km, estimated at 4.3 bn lei; contracts were reported signed with UMB in May 2026, with 6 months of design and 24 months of construction. That lot is in its design or early-works phase.
node.a8_route_near_pascani: A8 Autostrada Unirii, Targu Neamt-Iasi-Ungheni (Section IV, 88.77 km). Lots: Lot 1 Motca (Targu Neamt)-Targu Frumos, about 27 km, with 36 bridges and overpasses (8.5 km), 4 tunnels (1.7 km) and 3 interchanges (Motca, Pascani, Targu Frumos). Its contract was signed in May 2026 with a consortium led by SA&PE Construct (with Tehnostrade, Spedition UMB, Euro-Asfalt), SAFE funding, 4.87 bn lei, 10 months of design plus 36 months of construction. A priority 5.5 km segment links the A8 to the A7; CNIR says it could be ready in about 12 months, which puts it around 2027 (wall-street.ro, 2026-10-09). Lot 2 Targu Frumos-Letcani (28.6 km) was awarded to Danlin XXL in April 2026. Lot 3 Letcani-Iasi (17.7 km) and Lot 4 Iasi-Pod Ungheni (15.5 km) are in the tender or award phase. West of the node, Section III Leghin-Targu Neamt/Motca (29.91 km, UMB, signed September 2023) is under construction. Status near Pascani: only the A8 stubs inside the turbine are being built now, under the A7 Lot 3 contract (OSM opening_date 2026 between lon 26.6779 and 26.7329). The rest is tagged construction in OSM with no date, so the A8 will not be usable before about 2027-2030. Route in OSM (ref=A8, name "Autostrada Unirii"): from the west at about 47.17401,26.44813 (towards Targu Neamt) it runs east through 47.19459,26.52459, 47.19931,26.54348, 47.19752,26.60770 (Motca node area, ramps around 47.197,26.61) and the Boureni tunnel (47.20459,26.63429 to 47.20558,26.63903). It continues through 47.20434,26.64734, 47.19960,26.66593 (a cut or tunnel section at layer -1, 26.659-26.668), 47.20353,26.67792 and 47.20930,26.69051, then enters the turbine and crosses the A7 at 47.21388,26.70568. East of the node it passes 47.21457,26.70974, 47.21435,26.73001, 47.20991,26.75071 (towards the Siret crossing / Stolniceni-Prajescu), 47.20356,26.79264, 47.20576,26.83326, 47.21270,26.87413, 47.21784,26.92177, 47.22168,26.96678 and 47.23040,27.00368, continuing east towards Targu Frumos. The A8 runs almost east-west at lat 47.20-47.22. Geometry confidence is medium: OSM alignments of design-stage lots may be approximate.
